# Tool catalog

Optional tools are standard Dev Container Features. A project selects a
tool by adding its Feature to the `features` object of
`.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` and rebuilding the container; aibox does
not install tools itself, and `customizations.aibox` never installs tools.

> **Preview status:** the aibox Features are not published to
> `ghcr.io/projectious-work/aibox-features` yet, and they are not submitted to the public
> Feature index. The references below are the planned ones. Acceptance
> tests publish the Features to a local registry with
> `scripts/v1-05-features.sh publish --registry <host>/<prefix>` from a
> source checkout.

The catalog has 120 Features: 117 owned by aibox and
3 upstream Features that aibox references by digest.

## Select a tool

Add the Feature reference with its options, then rebuild:

```jsonc
{
  "features": {
    "ghcr.io/projectious-work/aibox-features/node/node:1": {"version": "26.13.0"},
    "ghcr.io/projectious-work/aibox-features/node/pnpm:1": {}
  }
}
```

- **Versions.** A Feature with a `version` option accepts only the listed
  values; the default is shown in bold. Anything else, including `latest`,
  a range or a URL, fails the build. Omit the option to get the default.
- **Dependencies.** Features listed under "adds" are installed
  automatically. Features listed under "select" are runtimes you choose
  yourself, at any offered version; the build fails if one is missing.
- **Disable a tool** by removing its Feature and rebuilding. There is no
  `enabled` option.
- **Bundles.** A `.../all` Feature installs every member of its group at
  default options. Selecting a bundle together with one of its members at
  another version fails, because one tool cannot have two versions.
- **Debian packages** come from the base image's configured repositories;
  the base's Debian snapshot, not the Feature, fixes their version.
- **Upstream Features** are referenced by digest with the listed options.

## Supported targets

Every Feature supports these targets; any other base fails before it
changes the image:

| Target | Distribution | Architecture |
|---|---|---|
| `debian-13-amd64` | Debian 13 (trixie) | amd64 |
| `debian-13-arm64` | Debian 13 (trixie) | arm64 |

## Build errors

A failing Feature writes one line
`aibox-feature error <CODE> feature=<catalog-id> <detail>` and stops the
build.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AIBOX_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED_TARGET` | The base is not Debian 13 (trixie) or the architecture is not amd64 or arm64. |
| `AIBOX_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION` | The version option is not in the Feature's enum. |
| `AIBOX_FEATURE_VERSION_CONFLICT` | The same tool is already installed at a different version, for example by a bundle and an explicit member selection. |
| `AIBOX_FEATURE_COUPLING_MISMATCH` | A Feature with versionCoupling finds its coupled Feature installed at a version the coupling rule does not allow. |
| `AIBOX_FEATURE_DEPENDENCY_MISSING` | A Feature listed in requires is not installed; the detail names the missing Feature ID. |
| `AIBOX_FEATURE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED` | A pinned artifact cannot be downloaded. |
| `AIBOX_FEATURE_VERIFICATION_FAILED` | A downloaded artifact fails its checksum or signature verification. |
| `AIBOX_FEATURE_PACKAGE_UNAVAILABLE` | A required Debian package has no installation candidate in the configured repositories. |

## Features

Atomic groups install all of their tools as one Feature; semantic groups
have one Feature per tool and an `all` bundle.

## Removed v0 tools

These v0 addon tools have no v1 Feature:

| v0 tool | Reason | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| `ADDON:ai-mistral/mistral` | Python SDK, not a CLI; belongs in project dependencies. | DEC-20261029_0835-HumbleBridge |
| `ADDON:docs-docusaurus/docusaurus` | @docusaurus/core is a project dependency pinned in package.json. | DEC-20261029_0835-HumbleBridge |
| `ADDON:docs-mkdocs/mkdocs` | MkDocs 1.x is unmaintained; Zensical reads mkdocs.yml. | DEC-20261029_0835-HumbleBridge |
| `ADDON:docs-starlight/starlight` | create-starlight is a one-time scaffolder; projects pin Starlight in package.json. | DEC-20261029_0835-HumbleBridge |
| `ADDON:preview-enhanced/rich` | Python rich library used only by aibox's own Yazi preview glue; previews render with glow and bat instead. | DEC-20261029_2107-QuietSeal |

## Compatibility notes

Differences from v0 that a migrated project may notice:

| Note | Affected v0 tools | Change |
|---|---|---|
| COMPAT-PIP | `ADDON:python/pip` | pip comes with the uv-managed CPython and is reached as python -m pip; a v0 'pip disabled' selection cannot be honored while python/python is selected. |
| COMPAT-OPENCODE | `ADDON:ai-opencode/opencode` | v0 installed the archived opencode-ai/opencode 0.0.55; v1 installs anomalyco/opencode, a different product with the same command name. |
| COMPAT-ATOMIC | `ADDON:audio-voice/sox`, `ADDON:audio-voice/sox-pulse`, `ADDON:audio-voice/pulseaudio-utils`, `ADDON:audio-voice/alsa-pulse`, `ADDON:data-visualization/vega-cli`, `ADDON:data-visualization/vega-lite`, `ADDON:mermaid/mermaid-cli`, `ADDON:mermaid/puppeteer` | audio-voice, data-visualization and mermaid are atomic in v1; a v0 selection that disabled only some members installs all of them or none. |
| COMPAT-GO-GROUP | `ADDON:go-quality/goimports`, `ADDON:go-quality/staticcheck`, `ADDON:go-quality/golangci-lint`, `ADDON:go-quality/govulncheck`, `ADDON:go-quality/gosec`, `ADDON:go-release/goreleaser` | go-quality and go-release tools are members of the semantic go group; go/all installs all of them. |
| COMPAT-SUPPLY-CHAIN | `ADDON:supply-chain/gitleaks`, `ADDON:supply-chain/osv-scanner`, `ADDON:supply-chain/syft`, `ADDON:supply-chain/grype`, `ADDON:supply-chain/cosign` | v0 supply-chain tools are members of security/scan; security/scan/all also installs semgrep. |
| COMPAT-PYTHON-UV | `ADDON:python/python`, `ADDON:ai-aider/aider`, `ADDON:ai-hermes/hermes`, `ADDON:ai-tau/tau`, `ADDON:docs-zensical/zensical`, `ADDON:data-preview/csvkit`, `ADDON:infrastructure/ansible`, `ADDON:python/poetry`, `ADDON:python/pdm` | Python and Python CLIs are managed by uv; Debian python3 is no longer installed by these Features. |
| COMPAT-ARM64-PINS | `ADDON:preview-archive/resvg`, `ADDON:mermaid/puppeteer` | v0 pins resvg 0.47.0 and puppeteer 25.9.0 have no arm64 builds; v1 defaults are resvg 0.49.0 and puppeteer 25.11.0. |
| COMPAT-LANG-PATCH | `ADDON:go/go`, `ADDON:node/node`, `ADDON:rust/rustc`, `ADDON:python/python` | Runtimes offer the newest patch of their three newest v0 lines; a v0 minor or major selection maps to that line's patch version, and older lines are not offered. |

| COMPAT-V0-REQUIRES | `ADDON:preview-enhanced/ffmpeg`, `ADDON:preview-enhanced/ghostscript`, `ADDON:go-release/goreleaser` | v0 recipe requires preview-enhanced -> preview-archive and go-release -> release have no functional dependency and are not mapped; go-release -> go maps to requires go/go. |
| COMPAT-DEBIAN-VERSION | `ADDON:audio-voice/alsa-pulse`, `ADDON:audio-voice/pulseaudio-utils`, `ADDON:audio-voice/sox`, `ADDON:audio-voice/sox-pulse`, `ADDON:data-preview/sqlite3`, `ADDON:diagramming/graphviz`, `ADDON:infrastructure/podman`, `ADDON:latex/svg-inkscape`, `ADDON:preview-archive/chafa`, `ADDON:preview-archive/entr`, `ADDON:preview-archive/librsvg`, `ADDON:preview-archive/mupdf`, `ADDON:preview-archive/p7zip`, `ADDON:preview-archive/poppler`, `ADDON:preview-archive/timg`, `ADDON:preview-enhanced/ffmpeg`, `ADDON:preview-enhanced/ghostscript` | Debian-route tools install the version the base's configured repositories provide; the base's snapshot pin, not the Feature, fixes their version. |
| COMPAT-AZURE | `ADDON:cloud-azure/azure-cli` | azure-cli is installed with uv from PyPI because Microsoft's apt repository has no trixie distribution. |
| COMPAT-RICH | `ADDON:preview-enhanced/rich` | v0 installed the python3-rich library for aibox's Yazi Markdown/JSON/RST/notebook previews. v1 removes rich; preview/enhanced/glow renders Markdown and preview/enhanced/bat highlights JSON, RST and front matter. Notebook preview is settled in V1-13. |
